newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fuji Heavy shares driven up by new vehicle demand.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Heavy shares driven up by new vehicle demand.

text.p: Fuji Heavy Industries Ltd shares were driven higher in Wednesday afternoon trade by news that orders for its new Forester light sport-utility vehicle were exceeding the firm's sales target, brokers said.
By 0430 GMT, the shares had climbed seven yen to 596 yen. Fuji Heavy's turnover soared to 6.558 million to become the second most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.
Brokers said that Fuji's share price was much lower than that of companies like Toyota Motor Corp and Honda Motor Co Ltd, making it a good buy.
Fuji Heavy said Wednesday it had received 4,000 domestic orders for its new Forester light sport-utility vehicle in the first 20 days after its launch.
Fuji Heavy, owned 4.2 percent by Nissan Motor, introduced the Forester four-wheel-drive SUV on February 13 in Japan with a monthly sales target of 3,000 units.
